game.title: Mechanic: Car Tuning Simulator
game.desc: 3D car mechanic simulator — build, repair, paint, wash, and restore vehicles piece by piece.
details: Team project at Azalea Games — my contribution was key systems and refactoring, not the full 1M+ release alone. I left the project in November 2025.
Built a modular 76-level Company mode (repair, paint, wash, rust removal) in ~1.5 weeks on configs and validators (SOLID).
Implemented reverse disassembly/assembly with a recursive parent-child structure and dynamic player hints.
Refactored the monolithic car spawn system to integrate the new mode without breaking legacy content.
Worked with Photon Fusion for multiplayer sessions — later removed it from the project.

game.title: KAZ Auto Sim
game.desc: Open-world car sandbox — cruise the city, take orders, unlock cars, and customize them.
details: Rebuilt the software architecture of a legacy mobile project in one month — final build size reduced 3×.
Crash-free sessions improved from 68% to 99.2%.
In-game phone UI with browser and 6 mini-apps — HUD and apps shipped in one week.
Vehicle customization: bass-reactive audio, hydraulics, tinting, interior lighting, and visual mods.
Custom Unity Editor tools cut per-car setup from 3–4 hours to ~20 minutes.

game.title: Offroad Snow: Driving Runner
game.desc: Off-road driving sim inspired by SnowRunner — mud deformation, winch mechanics, and open-world missions. Solo project.
details: Solo full-cycle development — from design document to Google Play and App Store release in ~1.5 months.
Mobile optimization: snow/mud shaders and stable 60 FPS on high settings on low-end devices.
Editor tools to speed up production (terrain chunking, vehicle setup tools, etc.).
For iOS: full UI rework in two days; complete tutorial built from scratch in one week.
